physics.symmetry: disabled consistently for ordered and thermally distorted snapshots

calculations.label: recommended-gamma
calculations.purpose: 12-snapshot feasibility and timing set; not the final 30-snapshot publication test set

numerical_convergence_preregistration.test_structures: one relaxed and one 800 K distorted snapshot, chosen by the frozen feasibility manifest
numerical_convergence_preregistration.freeze_rule: Select the cheapest setting for which raising cutoffs, k-point density, and SCF strictness changes relative energy by <=1 meV/atom, every force component by <=0.01 eV/A, and every stress component by <=0.1 GPa.

model_domain_acceptance.systematic_failure_rule: No temperature-, occupancy-, or element-specific monotonic bias large enough to reverse the scientific conclusion.
model_domain_acceptance.failure_action: Do not relax thresholds. Fine-tune a separately versioned potential with a disjoint held-out test set, or narrow/withdraw the transport claim.
